notes.title: ToS Gamepad Companion v2.01
notes.content:
ToS Gamepad Companion v2.01 is live now!

Features & improvements include:


 Rewritten Vibration Backend  - All of the vibration functions have been rewritten to accommodate the combination of delays. (Yes, this required rewriting all of it :( )
 Combine Delays  - You can now combine the 'Delay Start' & 'Delay End'! 
 Motor Strength Pre-Sets  - Motors have been renamed to Low & High (rather than left & right); you can now quickly and easily set the motors to Low, High or Both!
 On Tap or On Hold  - You can now set whether you want to hold to button to activate vibration or just tap the button to make vibration happen. When using On Tap you can set the Delay End to decide how long your gamepad will vibrate for once a button has been tapped! 


Cheers.

Takeover Studios.

notes.title: ToS Gamepad Companion v2.0
notes.content:
ToS Gamepad Companion v2.0 is live now!

This has been a long time in the making, but it is finally here! The completely new redesign is built from the ground up. The base app is now free, with new features coming soon. 

For those who bought 'Vibration Companion', they have received the 'ToS Gamepad Companion - Vibration Companion' DLC for free!

More features will be coming soon with lots of new things planned for ToS Gamepad Companion!

Features & improvements include:


 Base App Free  - The base app is now completely free and has more features (and coming new features). 
 Completely Redesigned  - ToS Gamepad Companion has been completely redesigned from the ground up, Vibration Companion has been completly remade and ToSGC is now ready to have even more features and functionality. 
 Gamepad Mouse  - Each gamepad has it's own mouse to navigate all of ToSGC
 Automatic Gamepad Detection  - Gamepads and their types are automatically detected.
 Updated Video Settings  - Video settings updated so you have more control over ToS Gamepad Companion.
 New Vibration Companion  - ToS Gamepad Companion - Vibration Companion has also been completely redesigned to be faster and simpler for the user.
 Vibration Companion - Motors  - You can now select the individual strengths of the left and right motors of your gamepad!
 Vibration Companion - Patterns  - You can now add vibration patterns to any button on your gamepad!
 Vibration Companion - Layouts  - Layouts have been updated and can now get up to 40 different layouts for all your games!
 Vibration Companion - Layout Names  - Layouts can now be renamed to whatever you want! 


Cheers.

Takeover Studios.

notes.title: Vibration Companion v1.01
notes.content:
Vibration Companion v1.01 is live now! 

Features & improvements include:


 Updated Backend  - Updated Unity project version to get the latest features, loading system, save system, UI menu system, Rewired Input system & more. 
 New Feedback Form  - There is now a feedback/bug report form that is accessible from the main menu. Leave feedback or bug reports to help improve Vibration Companion!
 Unity Cloud Builds  - Vibration Companion builds have now moved to Unity Cloud builds allowing for better and more consistent builds.
 Demo Updates  - Vibration Companion Demo has been updated to reflect latest updates
 Non-Steam Editions Updated  - Non-Steam Editions have been updated to reflect latest updates
 Imported Steam Integration  - Steam integration has been set up but currently not ready for release. Will be available in future updates. 


Plans for the future include more features for the base version of Vibration Companion, new features for the Upgrade Pack and a new planed DLC. No ETA on when these will happen but hopefully in a timely manner. (In other words much sooner than it took for this update to come out, sorry for the delay!)

Cheers.

Takeover Studios.
